title: Developments
intro: Your new-build projects: their units, prices and the agencies that may sell them.

create.title: New development
create.intro: Name it and place it; units, prices and sharing follow on its page. A new development is shared with nobody yet.

editor.title: Development {ref}
editor.verify: Confirm units and prices are current
editor.fixedCommission: A fixed commission is set ({amount}); clear the field to remove it or enter a percentage to replace it.
editor.readOnly: Another agency's development: you can read it and write your own texts for your channels.

access.title: Sharing
access.intro: Who may see and sell this development. Sharing needs a verified agency.
access.noPartners: Add agencies on the Preferred agencies page to name them here.

units.title: Units
units.empty: No units yet. Import a CSV to add them.
units.selectAll: Select every unit on this page

import.title: Import units from a CSV
import.hint: A header row with ref and type (a property type's name), and any of bedrooms, bathrooms, internal_m2, terrace_m2, plot_m2, floor, orientation, price, status. Comma or semicolon separated; at most 500 rows.

priceLists.title: Price lists
priceLists.intro: Upload the developer's latest price list: you see what changes against the units as they are, then approve it to apply the prices and statuses.
priceLists.hint: A header row with ref and price, optionally status. An empty price means on request.
priceLists.approved: Version {version} approved: prices and statuses applied.

diff.title: Changes in version {version}
diff.addedHint: Not applied: create these units first (import a CSV), then upload the list again.
diff.removedHint: Not applied: delete these units yourself if they are no longer offered.
diff.none: No changes against the current units.

reasons.unknownType: no property type has this name
reasons.noHeader: the header row lacks the required columns

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some values are not valid; check the marked fields.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this development. Reload the page to see their changes.
errors.VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Your agency must be verified to share a development.
errors.DEVELOPMENT_NOT_FOUND: This development does not exist or was deleted.
errors.DEVELOPMENT_REF_TAKEN: Another development of your agency has this reference.
errors.UNIT_NOT_FOUND: This unit no longer exists; reload the page.
errors.UNIT_REF_TAKEN: A unit with one of these references already exists.
errors.DEVELOPMENT_UNIT_LIMIT: A development holds at most 2,000 units.
errors.PRICE_LIST_NOT_FOUND: This price list no longer exists; reload the page.
errors.PRICE_LIST_REVIEWED: This price list was already approved.
errors.PRICE_LIST_SUPERSEDED: A newer price list was uploaded; approve that one instead.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many changes at once; wait a moment.
